common_mistakes.mistake: Board without ballast, or put equal ballast loads on both decks.
common_mistakes.consequence: Both-rider presence alone is insufficient: equal weight stalls the cable, safely.
common_mistakes.recovery: Restore a one-sac difference appropriate to desired travel; boarding/weight feedback distinguishes this from lack of power.
